study: HCSN real-retrieval economy encoder controls, supplementary decision-stage study
preregistration: After the primary design and before opening either held-out evaluation. Zero raw audiovisual embedding learning. No primary model or threshold change.
identity: Reuse the primary RAVDESS physical timestamps, fixed gallery, actor shards, three actions, costs, TRAIN teacher, TRAIN standardization, ridge-SVD and acceptance criteria.
audio: Input to the readout is the 8 standardized free x coordinates only. No fitted nonlinear features; the three seed repetitions are deterministic duplicates.
lif: Nine causal discrete time LIF units. W[8,9] fixed seeded N(0,1/8). v0=0. v_pre=exp(-dt/1.0)*v+xW+input_bias, binary spike=[v_pre>=0.5*exp(log_threshold_bias)], v=v_pre-spike*threshold. The readout uses x and nine 0/1 spike outputs only. BP differentiates the hard forward with a sigmoid straight-through derivative, gain 4. Only the two scalar input/threshold biases are eligible for BP.
attention: One causal self-attention head, width 9. Q,K,V separately seeded W[8,9]~N(0,1/8); W_out[9,9]~N(0,1/9), all frozen. Prefix attention uses QK'/3 + lag_bias*(query_time-key_time), masks later keys to minus infinity. Output=tanh(attended_values W_out+output_bias). The readout uses x and nine resulting channels. Only the two scalar lag/output biases are eligible for BP.
randomness: Fresh torch.Generator(device=cpu) seeded identically for each declared encoder and seed. Draw fixed weights in the declared order, FP64. All editable scalar biases start at zero.
optimization: Identical primary centered multi-output ridge solve, lambda 0.001. KEEP fits only the 3-action readout. BP makes four profiled outer updates (Adam lr=.075, L2 radius=.35), refitting the head for each candidate. Worst RETAIN actor utility delta >= -0.05 versus same encoder/seed KEEP and highest DEV utility; ties prefer incumbent. The free-audio direct linear head omits BP. Numeric thresholds, seeds, actor splits and candidate gallery stay fixed.
budget: 15 separate cold fit processes, 80 TRAIN, 32 DEV and 28 RETAIN queries. After all 15 selected fit SHA256 are sealed, a separate process may score 48 TEST queries/6 actors. No TEST scores or file read in fit stage. Nominal readout + nine features matches primary readout width for LIF and attention; accounting separates frozen projection parameters, two editable scalars and fitted shared readout.
endpoint: Report all 15 outcomes, read/wait/stop mix, utility, R@1, worst actor versus matched KEEP, all cold process wall costs and failures. Common gates: utility >=.60, R@1 >=.70, worst actor delta >=-.05 for all 3 seeds. A small fixed encoder tests the origin of useful features under the study budget. It does not estimate a mature SNN/Transformer performance ceiling.
